name: Ontology lookup
description: Find standard terms (OBI, ChEBI, Cell Ontology, UBERON, NCBI Taxonomy, units and more) in the EBI Ontology Lookup Service, so a field or a vocabulary term can name what it means.
author: Sheetbase

operations.title: Search ontology terms
operations.description: Finds standard ontology terms for a word or phrase in the EBI Ontology Lookup Service, such as `HEK293` (Cell Line Ontology) or `sodium chloride` (ChEBI). Only the words searched leave the workspace. Each term has a label, an ontology, its short id, a link and a short description. Cite terms only from these results.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: The word or phrase, such as `buffer solution`.

inputs.name: ontologies
inputs.description: Only these ontologies, comma separated: obi, chebi, cl, uberon, ncbitaxon, uo, efo, go, bao, clo, bto, pato. All six defaults if left out.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: At most this many, up to 30. Default 15.
